thread:
incident-bot: ALERT: SLO breach detected for /v1/generate (p99 latency > 4s) for the last 3m. Streaming stalls observed. Severity: P1. Context: recent deployment (2026-03-15T10:20Z) includes quantization profile v2 (int8) rollout to 30% of traffic. Metrics: p95 1.1s -> 2.4s, p99 1.9s -> 6.8s, active streams with stalls count ++.

alice: acked. I'm oncall. Jumping in. Any immediate mitigation runbooks?

bob: looking at runtime. I see a sharp increase in GPU stall time and host-side memcpy spikes starting at 10:22Z. Kernel logs show more frequent cache flushes. Correlates exactly with canary percentage bump to 30%.

carol: ML infra: the quant profile change was pushed to canary at 10:18Z, then traffic ramped to 30% at 10:21Z. The profile toggles `use_int8_weights=true` and a new calibration table is in S3: s3://redwood-quant/profiles/modelX/v2/calib.json

alice: quick question — which models are impacted? Only modelX family or others?

bob: initial sampling: modelX-small and modelX-medium accounts for ~68% of canary traffic. modelY unaffected.

eve: CS: we're getting customer pings about slow streaming in chat widgets. High-value customers on Dedicated reported stalls around 10:25Z. Need to surface this to sales/CS.

dan: SRE: set page to all oncall and start mitigation. Also create incident bridge. 

incident-bot: Incident bridge created: https://meet.link/incident/1710601234. Pager duty: oncall escalation notified.

alice: immediate mitigation plan proposal: 1) pause further rollout 2) roll traffic on canary back to 5% 3) enable fast-fallback to fp16 variant for streaming sessions 4) gather traces for p99 requests. Who can execute 2/3 now?

bob: I can throttle canary at the router layer. Command to adjust weight: `rtrctl set-weight modelX-canary 5` — applying now.

carol: I can flip fallback flag in model router config so sessions get fp16 variant if stall detected: `streaming.fallback_on_stall = true`. Applying patch to config and pushing.

alice: doing customer comms template now. Eve, can you draft a short note for impacted customers? Keep it honest: "investigating increased tail latency; mitigation in progress".

eve: drafting and will send to CS channel + selected customers.

bob: router weight update completed at 10:32Z. Canary weight from 30% -> 5%. Monitoring now.

incident-bot: Automation: rollback-suggested for quant profile v2 on modelX. Would you like to trigger rollback? (reply `yes` to accept)

carol: quick note: v2 included a calibration change where we switched to percentile-based quant bins. Calibration fallback to previous table is possible: `s3://redwood-quant/profiles/modelX/v1/calib.json`

alice: decision: initiate rollback of quantization profile for modelX canary to v1. bob/carol please coordinate.

bob: rolling profile back on serving nodes. Command: `deployctl set-quant-profile modelX canary v1` — starting. Logs: "deployctl: rolling profile on 42 nodes, batch size 8".

carol: confirming artifact fetch and checksum. v1 checksum mismatch found on 3 nodes; forcing re-sync.

bob: rollback completed at 10:44Z. Observed p99 fall from 6.8s -> 2.1s within 90s after rollback. Streaming stalls reduced.

alice: good. Are we seeing customer impact clearing?

eve: CS: initial replies from 3 customers say performance is back to normal. I'll keep monitoring for any follow-ups.

dan: SRE: keep canary at 5% and hold rollout. We'll need a postmortem and rollback/runbook for quant changes. Also add spike detection for calibration fallout.

bob: root cause hypothesis: int8 profile v2 introduced calibration bins that increase memory traffic and occasionally trigger a rare execution path in kernel that stalls for long-tailed sequences (likely due to underflow/overflow handling). The tail effect disproportionately affects streaming since it touches KV cache and emissions frequently.

carol: reproduction plan: run calibration regen with a held-out prompt set of long-context conversational sessions, use `quant-test --calib s3://.../v2 --stress-streams 2000 --seed 42`. I can run baseline tests in staging.

alice: ownership: postmortem owner = carol, action owner for runtime kernel trace = bob, oncall follow-up = alice. Timeline: postmortem draft due EOD, full RCA and mitigations due within 48h.

incident-bot: Incident severity downgraded to P2 at 11:05Z. All hands clear but follow-ups required.

alice: handoff note for next oncall (to be delivered at 11:30Z): rollback executed, canary held at 5%, fallback enabled, CS patched customers contacted. Please watch p95/p99 for modelX for next 12h and escalate if p99 > 3s or streaming stalls > 5 per minute.

bob: adding a temporary metric `quant_profile_stall_rate{profile=v2}` to track any stray nodes still using v2. Also adding a kernel-level counter for memcpy stalls.

carol: will run calibration regen and a synthetic long-tail job in staging (job id: qreg-171060) and link artifacts in the postmortem.

eve: sent customer updates at 10:50Z to impacted list. Will follow up if any customers reopen tickets.

dan: thanks team. Good triage. We need to formalize a canary checklist for quant changes: calibration sanity checks, kernel perf smoke, staged long-tail tests, and customer-facing canary limits. Add to follow-ups.

alice: adding follow-up items to incident board: 1) canary checklist 2) automatic rollback on p99 > 3s 3) add quant-profile shadow testing 4) postmortem doc (owner: carol).

incident-bot: Incident closed (mitigated) at 11:10Z. Postmortem link placeholder: /incidents/1710601234/postmortem (draft).
